description.title: Layup
description.summary: This table details the conditions for temporarily taking a vehicle off the road (layup) under an insurance policy. It outlines how to request layup, the impact on insurance coverage, and how fees are refunded.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את התנאים להשבתת רכב באופן זמני (״השבתה״) במסגרת פוליסת ביטוח. ניתן להשתמש בטבלה זו כדי להבין כיצד לבקש השבתה, מה ההשפעה על כיסוי הביטוח וכיצד מוחזרים דמי הביטוח. בקשת השבתה צריכה להימסר מראש בכתב או בכל דרך אחרת, לתקופה של 30 יום רצופים לפחות. הפוליסה תתחדש עם אישור השבתה. במקרה של ביטול השבתה, המבטח יחזיר חלק יחסי מדמי הביטוח, בניכוי דמי ביטוח עבור הכיסוי שסופק.

sketch:
22. Layup
22.1 A policy owner or a person requesting that a policy be issued for the use of a motor vehicle under paragraph 22.5, may notify the insurer in advance, in writing or in any other way, of layup of the vehicle for a period of no less than 30 consecutive days (in this paragraph - layup request); The insurer shall document the layup request.
22.2 The insurer shall provide the policy owner with a new insurance certificate as stated in paragraph 22.5; The vehicle shall not be used or parked as noted in the definition of "use of a motor vehicle" in paragraph 1, and the insurer's liability will be limited in accordance with paragraphs 3 and 6 so that it will not apply to these uses.
22.3 The policy owner may cancel the layup policy by providing the insurer with a notice; the layup period will end on the date noted in the aforementioned notice, provided that the end of the layup period will not be retroactive.
22.4 In the event that the layup policy is canceled according to paragraph 22.3, the insurer shall return to the policy owner the proportional part of the insurance fees for the cover under paragraphs 3 and 6 and according to this paragraph, less insurance fees for the cover provided in regard to the layup; the refund as aforementioned shall be for a layup period of 30 days or more.

22.3 The policy owner may cancel the layup policy by providing the insurer with a notice; the layup period will end on the date noted in the aforementioned notice, provided that the end of the layup period will not be retroactive.
22.4 In the event that the layup policy is canceled according to paragraph 22.3, the insurer shall return to the policy owner the proportional part of the insurance fees for the cover under paragraphs 3 and 6 and according to this paragraph, less insurance fees for the cover provided in regard to the layup; the refund as aforementioned shall be for a layup period of 30 days or more.
